fact: Chad has asked the ITU, under GENIE.AI, to support an 'AI for Good Lab-Tchad', which per ADETIC is to have a sandbox and a national public AI computing infrastructure hosted in the national datacentre, and the government created the AI research laboratory LIDIA within the CNRD in 2026.
title: IA : le Tchad veut renforcer ses capacités nationales avec un laboratoire soutenu par l’UIT
